name: Vishnu Lakshmi
review: Hey! Good evening, This is Vishnu Lakshmi :)) As a dancer and basically your typical girl who lovess to dress up, I always like to find comfort, beauty and uniqueness in one place / package. Aishwarya Silks delivered and continues to deliver only the best that exceeds my expectations. The sarees I've bought from here (which are basically all my sarees) are not only comfortable to wear but they're also really light and stand out from the usual patterns or color combinations

name: Sneha
review: As a dance artist, I am committed to preserving and promoting the traditions, culture, and art that have shaped my identity. Am grateful to Sri Aishwarya Sarees for their dedication to preserving our heritage through their authentic designs. Sarees empower me to perform with confidence, allowing my movements to soar with uninhibited grace. Am truly thankful for Sri Aishwarya Sarees' unwavering commitment to upholding our traditions and for including me in their authentic Journey.

name: Lakshmi R.
review: My mother bought her wedding saree from Sri Aishwarya in 1978. I bought mine in 2009. Last week, my daughter chose hers. Some places never lose their soul.

name: Meera Iyer
review: The silk cotton sarees are unmatched. The zari is real, the weave is honest, and the people behind the counter treat you like family.

name: Priya Sundaram
review: I live abroad now and their video consultation made me feel like I was back in Mylapore. The saree arrived perfectly packed and exactly as promised.

name: Anitha K.
review: Solid collection and extremely helpful staff. The silk cotton range is genuinely traditional — exactly what I had been looking for.

name: Rajalakshmi V.
review: Spacious outlet, great variety, and very warm staff. Excellent personalised service every single visit. Happy experience every time.

name: Geetha M.
review: Visited again and could not turn my eyes away from the colourful handloom collection. Genuine quality, dignified service. Highly recommend.
